node: Delivery marketplaces, first-party ordering, loyalty, and customer-data infrastructure
summary: Layer 1B expands the public-stock universe around the restaurant digital-demand chokepoint. The reference lane is DoorDash as the marketplace aggregator that sets the external distribution benchmark. The underfollowed lane emphasizes middleware/POS/payment vendors that may benefit if restaurants try to reduce marketplace dependency by owning ordering, loyalty, guest data, payments, and kitchen-routing workflows. Olo is highly relevant to the node but appears to have been acquired by Thoma Bravo and should be treated as a private-company comparator rather than a current US-listed candidate.
